name: Exp_Karacatica
summary: This EA trades breakout signals generated by the custom 'Karacatica' indicator, which is based on ATR. It opens buy positions on upward breakout signals and sell positions on downward breakout signals, with optional position closing on opposite signals. Money management is configurable with multiple margin modes including fixed lot sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标'Karacatica'（基于ATR）产生的突破信号进行交易。在向上突破信号时开多仓，向下突破信号时开空仓，并可选择在反向信号时平仓。资金管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于Karacatica指标的突破信号进行交易，该指标内部使用ATR（平均真实波幅）来衡量市场波动性并生成突破信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）产生非空非零信号时开多仓，当缓冲区0（DnValue）产生非空非零信号时开空仓。出场条件为：当出现反向突破信号时平掉对应仓位（多仓出现下突破信号时平多，空仓出现上突破信号时平空），同时设有固定的止损和止盈点位。仓位管理方面，EA通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线最多产生一次信号，避免重复开仓。资金管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例以及固定手数模式。EA还包含一个额外的历史回溯检查逻辑，当同时允许开仓和平仓但当前无平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找是否有遗漏的平仓信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on breakout signals generated by the Karacatica indicator, which internally uses ATR (Average True Range) to measure market volatility and produce breakout signals. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-empty, non-zero signal, and open a sell position when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a non-empty, non-zero signal. Exit conditions are: close a buy position when a downward breakout signal appears, and close a sell position when an upward breakout signal appears, with configurable fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels in points. For position management, the EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure at most one signal per bar, preventing repeated entries on the same candle. Money management supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot mode. The EA also includes an additional historical lookback check logic: when both opening and closing are enabled but no close signal exists on the current signal bar, it traverses forward through historical bars to find any missed closing signals.

parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损后保证金/扣除亏损后余额/固定手数）

parameters.name: SellPosClose

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号所在K线索引（0=当前K线）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于ATR突破信号进行交易，适应市场波动性变化
资金管理模式丰富，提供五种不同的仓位计算方式，灵活性强
内置IsNewBar机制防止同一K线重复开仓，避免信号重复执行
买卖开仓和平仓均可独立开关控制，策略配置灵活度高
包含历史回溯平仓信号检查逻辑，减少遗漏平仓信号的风险
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on ATR breakout signals that adapts to market volatility changes
Rich money management modes offering five different position sizing methods for high flexibility
Built-in IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate entries on the same bar, avoiding signal repetition
Independent toggle switches for buy/sell opening and closing provide high configuration flexibility
Historical lookback logic for closing signals reduces the risk of missing exit signals
cons: 止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率环境下风险收益比不一致
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在点差较大或低流动性时段可能产生不利成交
历史回溯平仓信号检查逻辑遍历所有历史K线，在K线数量较多时存在性能问题
依赖外部自定义指标Karacatica且使用iCustom调用，缺乏指标源码时难以回测和优化
没有最大持仓数量限制和最大回撤控制等全局风控机制
cons_en: Fixed point StopLoss/TakeProfit instead of ATR-based dynamic calculation leads to inconsistent risk-reward ratios across different volatility environments
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
The historical lookback closing signal check iterates through all historical bars, causing potential performance issues with large bar counts
Depends on external custom indicator Karacatica via iCustom call, making backtesting and optimization difficult without the indicator source code
No global risk controls such as maximum position count limits or maximum drawdown protection
improvements: 将固定点数止损止盈改为基于ATR倍数的动态止损止盈，使风险收益比随市场波动性自适应调整
添加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在不利交易条件下开仓，并设置全局风控参数如最大持仓数和最大回撤限制
优化历史回溯平仓信号检查逻辑，设置最大回溯K线数量限制以避免性能问题
improvements_en: Replace fixed-point StopLoss/TakeProfit with ATR-multiple-based dynamic stops to make risk-reward ratios self-adaptive to market volatility
Add spread filter and trading session controls to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions, and implement global risk controls like maximum position count and maximum drawdown limits
Optimize the historical lookback closing signal check logic by setting a maximum lookback bar count limit to avoid performance issues

risk_points: 固定止损1000点和止盈2000点在低波动品种上可能过大，在高波动品种上可能过小
历史回溯平仓检查无K线数量上限，理论上可能遍历全部历史数据导致卡顿
缺少点差过滤，在点差扩大的新闻事件或低流动性时段可能以不利价格成交
SignalBar=1时信号有一根K线延迟，但设为0时可能在未完成的K线上产生虚假信号
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP may be too large for low-volatility instruments and too small for high-volatility ones
Historical lookback closing check has no bar count limit, potentially iterating through all history causing lag
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills during news events or low-liquidity sessions when spreads widen
SignalBar=1 introduces one-bar signal delay, but SignalBar=0 may generate false signals on uncompleted bars
